# shibumistack.dev

> A small web stack: Bun, Hono, Zod, Drizzle, SQLite, Alpine, and Nanostores. Clear seams. No hidden runtime.

## Pages

- [Home](/index.md)
- [Roadmap](/building.md)
- [shibumi-server](/server.md)
- [DX plan](/dx.md)
- [Brand](/brand.md)

## In development

- [`shibumi-server`](/server.md): an experimental, open-source Bun service for signed GitHub webhook deploys to rootless Podman behind Caddy, with memory/disk preflight and bounded builds. Public templates contain no machine credentials; real configuration and secrets stay on the VPS.
